visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-width map image with circular markers that open embedded media.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Interactive image map: circular markers positioned on a background image open Dynamic Media video, 3D viewer, image or text panels.

contentPattern.summary: Interactive image map: hotspots on a background image open Dynamic Media video / 3D viewer iframes. No library block covers it; left unresolved for a custom block.
contentPattern.structure: row 1 background image (image or image URL); then one row per hotspot with three cells: content URL or text, left position (x%), top position (y%)

blockContent.rows: row 1: background image; one row per hotspot

occurrences.reason: Interactive image map: hotspots on a background image open Dynamic Media video / 3D viewer iframes. No library block covers it; left unresolved for a custom block.

usage: Row 1: background image (image or image URL). Then one row per hotspot: content cell (Dynamic Media video /play URL, viewer page URL such as a 3D/dimensional viewer, image URL, or text), left position (e.g. 38.5%), top position (e.g. 39%).
reuseGuidance: Use for interactive image maps where markers open media. Positions are percentages of the image size so markers stay aligned at every width.
